title: Operator kit
description: Hand-written hit structure of an operator's skills: which blackboard values multiply into each hit and how often it lands. Numbers come from the game tables; only structure is written here. Each kit lists its sources.

element.description: Default element of the operator's hits.

activeConditions.description: What the game's condition IDs on this operator's talent and potential effects (PotentialTalentEffectTable activeCondition) mean, as Predicates; cite where the meaning comes from in the kit's sources.

buffs.description: Timed buffs and debuffs the operator's hits apply (engine buffs.ts): on themselves, the team, or the enemy (acting on every team member's hits). Values come from the game data (valueSpec).

gameBuff.description: The BuffData buff this stands for; when it is priority-keyed (stackingType 1), instances from different operators don't add up (only the strongest counts).

duration.description: Seconds; 0: not applied (a buff a potential unlocks has 0 below it). Absent: until a trigger ends it or a cast consumes it.

modifiers.description: Empty for a state that only gates skills (availableWhile).

attr.description: An attribute instead of a zone (mapped to its zone like any stat; one that doesn't act on hits, e.g. Ultimate Gain Efficiency 44, is read where the game reads it).

items.description: A zone or an attribute (exactly one; the loader checks).

maxStacks.description: Layered (BuffData stackingType 2 / 11): up to this many instances from one owner, each with its own duration; at the maximum a new one replaces the oldest. Modifiers add up per layer.

recipients.description: Team buffs only: the members it reaches, judged per member at application with the applier as owner (isOwner, sameElementAsOwner, operatorProfession, operatorElement).

consumedBy.description: The next cast of these kinds by someone it reaches consumes it; it then acts on that cast's hits only (Link, Jade Vessel's combo bonus).

every.description: Periodic: a buffTick event every this many seconds while active, for triggers.

tickOnApply.description: The first tick comes when it's applied (default: one interval later).

blocksEnergy.description: While active, its owner gains no ultimate energy (RefrainObtainUsp).

triggers.description: What the kit does when things happen in the fight (engine events.ts): combo windows (openCombo; quote the CharGrowthTable COMBO TRIGGER text in the note), team effects, talents. Without an openCombo trigger the timeline allows the combo whenever it's off cooldown.

finalStrike.description: Only Final Strikes (true) or only other hits (false); SkillData mask bit 2097152.

skills.description: Only casts of these skill IDs (a skill's own effects at frames, with delay).

buff.description: One of the kit's own buffs.

toOthers.description: Only heals of someone other than the healer.

by.description: Whose events count. Stack and own-buff events are always the owner's.

if.description: Judged for the owner when the event happens.

cooldown.description: Seconds before it can fire again.

cooldownPer.description: The cooldown counts per event subject (the healed operator of a heal, else the event's operator).

maxCount.description: At most this many times per fight.

delay.description: Frames after the event when the actions run (the trigger's if is judged at the event, each action's own if when it runs).

skill.description: The skill (or talent / potential source) plain value keys name.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

amount.description: How many (default 1); {"consumed": true} for the infliction stacks the hit consumed.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

percentOfMax.description: value is a fraction of the owner's maximum energy (isPercentValue).

ignoreEfficiency.description: Not scaled by Ultimate Gain Efficiency (ignoreUspGainScalar).

ignoreBlock.description: Given even while energy gain is blocked (useUspRecoverTag).

value.description: Returned SP (gives no ultimate energy when spent).

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

to.description: A team buff for the event's subject only: the healed operator of a heal, else the operator who caused the event.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

layers.description: End only the oldest this many layers (default: all).

seconds.description: Seconds added to the remaining cooldown (negative cuts it).

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

hits.description: Landed as the trigger's owner, at frames counted from the event; scale keys name the trigger's skill.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

seconds.description: Added to the remaining time of every active layer (a state a skill pauses).

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).
This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

skill.description: One of the owner's kit skills, cast by itself (SkillData CastSkill): no control, cost or cooldown; it ends the owner's current skill.

if.description: This action only in this situation (judged for the owner when it runs).

statusTweaks.description: How the statuses this operator applies differ from the standard ones (Arcane's talent: Corrosion lasts longer, shreds more).

capScale.description: Multiplier on the strength cap (Corrosion's shred cap).

skill.description: Where plain value keys come from (an own skill or a talent / potential source).

stacks.description: The operator's own counters (e.g. Laevatain's Melting Flame) that hits gain and require.

initial.description: At the start of a fight (default 0); name sources explicitly ({key, skill}), e.g. a talent's attached buff. A scenario's startStacks overrides it.

available.description: Castable only when this holds for the operator at the start frame (a state: buffActive; a stance: not buffActive; …).

energyBlockSeconds.description: The operator gains no ultimate energy for this long after the cast (SkillData RefrainObtainUsp buff duration).

teamEnergyFrame.description: Frames from the cast to the team's energy for the SP it spends (SkillData CreateBuff buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp); at the cast when absent.

durationFrames.description: How long the skill locks the operator, in 30 FPS frames (SkillData durationFrame unless the skill can be cancelled earlier; say which in a note).

takesControl.description: The caster becomes the controlled operator at the cast (ultimates: 'becomes the controlled operator').

cooldownGroup.description: Skills sharing a group share one cooldown: casting one puts every member on its own cooldown (Typhoeus's two combos).

chainStep.description: Override: a basic-attack chain step, castable only while the chain points at it (default from the data: an earlier step's cancel window lists it).

anyOf.description: The element the enemy already has (none: nothing happens).

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

durationKey.description: Skill blackboard value giving the status duration in seconds, when the skill sets it.

scaleKey.description: Skill blackboard value multiplying the status's damage over time.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).
Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

stacks.description: At most this many (the rest stays, with its timer); all when absent.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).
Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

forced.description: A Lift / Knock Down that lands without Vulnerable (forceAirborne / forceKnockDown).

multiplierKey.description: Skill value multiplying the status's hit (CrushAction damageMultiplier).

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

status.description: The control status (the game's tag), e.g. immobilization.

durationKey.description: Skill value giving its duration in seconds.

freezes.description: It stops the enemy's own clock meanwhile (an entity time dilation of scale 0).

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

oneOf.description: A value of one of the operator's own skills at the build's skill level, after potentials.

predicate.description: When something happens (engine expr.ts Predicate). Judged with what's known at that moment; the log checker tries both outcomes of what a log can't tell.

oneOf.description: Panel attribute [0] ≥ [1] (attribute IDs; Arcane: Intellect 41 ≥ Will 42 is INT mode).

controlled.description: The operator is the controlled one (for a hit: when its skill was cast).

enemyModifier.description: The enemy has a buff from anyone with a modifier in this zone that reaches this element (an all-element one counts).

operatorElement.description: The operator's element is one of these.

operatorProfession.description: The operator's profession (CharacterTable profession number) is one of these.

isOwner.description: The operator is the effect's owner (false for a teammate a team buff reaches).

sameElementAsOwner.description: The operator has the effect owner's element.

eventOperator.description: Judged for the operator who caused the event a trigger reacts to.

enemyPhysical.description: The enemy has this physical status.

enemyVulnerable.description: The enemy has at least this many Vulnerable stacks.

enemyControl.description: The enemy has this control status.

valueExpr.description: A number from the game data (engine expr.ts ValueExpr): a literal; a string = a skill value of the skill in context (at the build's level, after potentials); or a combination.

events.description: Event keys battle logs (ZMDLogs) use for this hit. Default: the skill ID, when the skill has a single hit entry.

frames.description: Frame (30 FPS, from the skill's start) at which each landing happens; one entry per count. Projectile travel time isn't in the data, so projectile hits use the launch frame.

bonuses.description: The hit's own zone bonuses from its skill's values (after potentials), e.g. a projectile's damage bonus on its first target.

factor.description: Literal multiplier from the skill graph (a SimpleCalcBB × or ÷ splitting a value, e.g. 0.5 for one of two arrows); cite it in the note.

reaction.description: The hit's damage is an arts burst or reaction (no skill-type bonus; level coefficient and Arts Intensity apply), times its scale keys, e.g. Typhoeus's own Nature burst.

energy.description: Ultimate energy the operator gains when the hit lands (SkillData ObtainCostAction costType 0, e.g. a combo's usp).

buffs.description: Kit buffs this hit applies when it lands; beforeDamage: the buff already acts on this hit.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

finalStrike.description: Override: whether the hit is a Final Strike. By default read from SkillData (decorate-mask bit 2097152) via the hit's events.

requires.description: The hit only happens if the operator's stack is in range (atLeast, below) when the skill is cast, judged before the cast uses anything up. consume: all of the stack (true) or that many (a value), once per cast and stack (the largest amount named); consumeAt: at the cast (default) or when this hit lands.

gains.description: Stacks gained when the hit lands: a fixed amount (default 1) or the infliction stacks the hit consumed.

amount.description: How many (default 1); {"consumed": true} for the infliction stacks the hit consumed.

if.description: Only in this situation (judged when it happens).

applies.description: What each landing does to the enemy's arts state, in order (packages/engine/src/status.ts). Skill descriptions say which hits inflict; the game data doesn't.

if.description: The hit happens only in this situation, judged as it lands, before its own effects (a mode, an enemy status…).

extraScale.description: Extra multipliers that apply only in a situation.

damageType.description: Triggered hits only (required there): which skill-type DMG bonus applies; none for no skill type. A skill's hits take the skill's.

heals.description: Whom the hit heals: an event for heal triggers (amounts aren't modelled).

sp.description: Returned SP when the hit lands (ObtainCostAction costType 1 at this hit); the skill's atb is then not added to its first hit.

detached.description: Lands even if the skill is interrupted before it (a projectile or ability entity already on its way); other hits still to land are cancelled when the operator starts another skill.

poise.description: Stagger damage (SkillData damage units of damageAttributeType 1, e.g. the skill's poise key).

poiseControlledOnly.description: Its stagger counts only while its operator is controlled (onlyEnableForMainChar: Final Strikes).
